t: A Bluetooth and Thread chip best known as the brain of the micro:bit V2.
steps: Buy a BBC micro:bit V2 from SparkFun or Adafruit for about 17 US dollars.
Plug it into your computer with a USB cable that carries data.
Open the free MakeCode editor in your web browser.
Drag blocks to make a heart flash on the LED grid.
Download the program and drag the file onto the micro:bit drive.
Try the microphone and speaker blocks next.
Move to the nRF52833 DK and the nRF Connect SDK later for Thread and Zigbee projects.
meta: Open Board. From $16.50. A few stores.
